## Single Zone Building

![Single Zone Building icon](../../assets/icons/SingleZoneBuildingComponent.png)

Component · nickname `1ZBldg` · GUID `50965154-e31e-4730-b61c-15a6f40bee6f` · exposure primary

The whole building as one zone, BUILDING: slabs become internal mass, walls between merged zones are discarded. Every rebuilt outdoor wall gets one centred window with the glazed area of the windows it covers.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Floors | `F` | [Floor](info.md#floor) | list | no | – | Floors, bottom to top. |
| Multipliers | `N` | Integer | list | yes | – | How many storeys each floor stands for (stacked explicitly before merging). Default 1. |
| Preview Location | `PL` | Vector | item | yes | `{0,0,0}` | Moves this component's viewport preview by this vector, in model units; the data and all outputs keep their true coordinates. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Building | `Bldg` | [Building](info.md#building) | item | The building. |

**Example definitions:** `gallery-bar.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/gallery-bar.png)), `open-court.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/open-court.png)), `operating-suite.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/operating-suite.png)), `radial-lobes.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/radial-lobes.png)).

## Single Zone per Floor Type

![Single Zone per Floor Type icon](../../assets/icons/SingleZonePerFloorTypeComponent.png)

Component · nickname `1ZType` · GUID `506d5037-de93-4aee-a6c4-47dcc97509e1` · exposure primary

One zone per floor entry: the storeys of entry i merge into zone E{i}. Slabs within an entry become internal mass, walls between merged zones are discarded, and floors and ceilings between entries stay between two zones. Every rebuilt outdoor wall gets one centred window with the glazed area of the windows it covers.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Floors | `F` | [Floor](info.md#floor) | list | no | – | Floors, bottom to top. |
| Multipliers | `N` | Integer | list | yes | – | How many storeys each floor stands for (stacked explicitly before merging). Default 1. |
| Preview Location | `PL` | Vector | item | yes | `{0,0,0}` | Moves this component's viewport preview by this vector, in model units; the data and all outputs keep their true coordinates. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Building | `Bldg` | [Building](info.md#building) | item | The building. |

**Example definitions:** `cafeteria.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/cafeteria.png)), `foyer-halls.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/foyer-halls.png)), `stair-pair.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/stair-pair.png)), `winged-band.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/winged-band.png)).

## Stack Floors

![Stack Floors icon](../../assets/icons/StackFloorsComponent.png)

## Stacked Floor Zone Multiplier

![Stacked Floor Zone Multiplier icon](../../assets/icons/StackedFloorZoneMultiplierComponent.png)

Component · nickname `ZMult` · GUID `e4b44821-c9ed-49b9-9c4e-7c08355254dd` · exposure primary

Representative storeys with zone multipliers (formerly Floor Area Multiplier). Each floor type stands for N storeys; floors and ceilings are designated on the whole stack, storeys with exposed floors or ceilings (ground, roof, setbacks, overhangs) are split off as x1 storeys so exposure is never multiplied, and storeys keep their true elevations. Pieces between storeys are adiabatic.

**Inputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Optional | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Floors | `F` | [Floor](info.md#floor) | list | no | – | Floors, bottom to top. |
| Multipliers | `N` | Integer | list | yes | – | How many storeys each floor type stands for. Default 1. |
| Preview Location | `PL` | Vector | item | yes | `{0,0,0}` | Moves this component's viewport preview by this vector, in model units; the data and all outputs keep their true coordinates. |

**Outputs**

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Building | `Bldg` | [Building](info.md#building) | item | The building. |

**Example definitions:** `care-hub.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/care-hub.png)), `court-cluster.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/court-cluster.png)), `office-plate.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/office-plate.png)), `point-plate.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/point-plate.png)), `stair-bay-bar.gh` ([canvas](../../assets/screenshots/canvas/stair-bay-bar.png)).
